title: Joel Gascoigne (Buffer CEO) — 'I already know it's going to make a real difference to Buffer'
summary: Joel Gascoigne — founder and CEO of Buffer, the long-running independent SaaS company that famously went remote-first, transparent-by-default, and resisted multiple acquisition attempts — posts on the eve of cracking Incorruptible that he already knows it's going to make a real difference at Buffer.
blockquote: Solo dinner tonight and time to get started with Incorruptible by Eric Ries. I'm super excited to dive in, my only fear is that I won't be able to put it down. And I already know it's going to make a real difference to Buffer. Here we go.
